name: Dream Hunter Remu -Kumo Baku Ito no To--
original_name: ドリームハンター麗夢 蜘蛛縛糸の都
source:
Ayanokouji Remu stands up to fight the danger in the city, but what was waiting for her was a bunch of perverted and cruel bug succubae.

First spiders, then various bugs and amphibians ravage her. Gangbangs with humans and more also included. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036617.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
绫小路雷梦挺身而出，与城市中的危险作斗争，但等待她的却是一群变态残忍的虫子魅魔。

首先是蜘蛛，然后是各种虫子和两栖动物蹂躏她。还包括与人类的轮奸等。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036617.html]DLsite English[/url]]
